claim: A bare status-effect name (`status false unmoving @unit 0.1`) is an unset variable, so the instruction applies nothing. Content constants need the @ prefix (`@unmoving`; some builds spell it `@status_<name>`).
why: StatusEffects.java declares `unmoving` etc.; LAssembler.var() only resolves `@name` against GlobalVars, so a bare name becomes putVar and reads null. StatusI does nothing when the effect is null.
